verdicts.why: Seed has 'a bit of' and the LEGO is 看了一点 => Watch a bit of; 'A little' is a gloss variant of 一点 that is about this sentence, not an orphan.
得 is a manner marker in the LEGO that the English 'speak more slowly' does not render separately.
的 relative marker is in the LEGO 我以前认识的人 but has no English word in 'someone I used to know'.
的 modifier marker is in LEGO 用完全一样的方式 but is not rendered in 'in exactly the same way'.
的 relative marker is in the LEGO 喜欢说英语的人 but not rendered in 'People who like speaking English'.
就是 is in the LEGO 那就是为什么 and glossed 'is'; the seed has 'That is why', so 'is (exactly)' is a gloss variant.
之内 is in the LEGO 一天之内 => In a day; 'in / within' glosses it, with 'within' not in the seed.
跟我 is in the LEGO 他在哪里跟我见面 and 'with me / me' glosses it; the seed ends 'meet me'.
用 is in the LEGO 用完全一样的方式 and is glossed 'in (by means of)', while the seed has 'in exactly the same way'.
让 is in the LEGO 让你告诉我; the seed 'I'd like you to tell me' has 'to', but 'to (have)' is not a substring.
原因 is in the LEGO 那不是原因 => That isn't why; 'the reason / why' glosses it, but 'the reason' is not in the seed.
介意 is in the seed and its LEGO, and 'Mind' is a literal gloss of a word the target 'No that's not a problem' does not render.
进行 is in the LEGO 进行对话 => To have a conversation; the seed has 'to have a conversation', but 'to carry on' is a gloss variant.
人 is in the LEGO, and the seed has 'someone', while 'someone / person' includes 'person', which is not in the seed.
能 is in the LEGO 能准备好, but the seed 'I'll be ready' does not render 'be able to'.
目前 is in the LEGO => So far; the seed has 'so far', but 'so far / up to now' is a gloss variant with 'up to now' not in the seed.
The seed has 'ei ole valmis' as 'pole veel valmis' (contraction plus interposed 'veel'), so no single contiguous substring is forced.
'laguntza' is the noun/lemma of 'laguntzen' in the seed; the LEGO is 'laguntzeko', so this is an inflected form of a word that is present.
'ez nahi' is the seed's 'ez dugu ... nahi' with the auxiliary 'dugu' (sibling C01) and object interposed.
'ez nahi' is the seed's 'ez du ... nahi' with the auxiliary 'du' (sibling C01) and 'isilik egon' interposed.
